own_obstructions: C1 neighborhood conjugacy to a dissipative constant-Jacobian planar Henon base with uniformly contracting one-dimensional fiber is excluded by two unstable multipliers.
C1 neighborhood conjugacy to a fixed-time map of an autonomous three-dimensional flow is excluded by a least-period-five cycle without multiplier one.
not_excluded: Poincare return maps and higher-dimensional flow realizations
Conjugacy defined only on a fractal invariant set
Other nonlinear coordinates, symbolic equivalences, time changes and known discrete models
scope: Bounded targeted review. An unsuccessful search is not evidence of universal historical uniqueness. Existing operator-equivalence audit remains applicable.
